'''Bettina G. Keller''' is a professor for Theoretical Chemistry at [[Free University of Berlin|Freie Universität Berlin]].<ref name="www.bcp.fu-berlin.de-2014">{{Cite web|date=2014-01-17|title=Bettina Keller|url=https://www.bcp.fu-berlin.de/en/chemie/chemie/forschung/PhysTheoChem/agkeller/Group-Members/Head/Bettina-Keller.html|access-date=2020-07-09|website=www.bcp.fu-berlin.de|language=en}}</ref>

== Life and education ==
Keller did her ''[[Abitur]]'' at the Remstal-Gymnasium [[Weinstadt]] in 2000.<ref name="www.bcp.fu-berlin.de-2014" /> In October 2000, she started her diploma studies at [[Karlsruhe Institute of Technology|University of Karlsruhe]], Germany.<ref name="www.bcp.fu-berlin.de-2014" /> In 2002, she continued her diploma studies at [[ETH Zurich|ETH Zürich]].<ref name="www.bcp.fu-berlin.de-2014" /><ref name="www.academia-net.org">{{Cite web|title=Jun.-Prof. Dr. Bettina Keller – AcademiaNet|url=https://www.academia-net.org/profil/jun-prof-dr-bettina-keller/1426944|access-date=2020-07-09|website=www.academia-net.org}}</ref> She received her diploma in 2005.<ref name="www.bcp.fu-berlin.de-2014" /><ref name="www.academia-net.org" /> The title of her diploma thesis was "Estimating the absolute entropy of a liquid based on a single molecular dynamics simulation under periodic boundary conditions."<ref name="www.bcp.fu-berlin.de-2014" /><ref name="www.academia-net.org" /> In 2005, she started her PhD studies in chemistry at [[ETH Zurich|ETH Zürich]].<ref name="www.academia-net.org" /><ref name="www.diejungeakademie.de">{{Cite web|title=Bettina Keller – Mitglieder – Die Junge Akademie|url=https://www.diejungeakademie.de/mitglieder/details/jamembers/show/member/370/|access-date=2020-07-09|website=www.diejungeakademie.de|archive-date=2020-07-10|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200710002030/https://www.diejungeakademie.de/mitglieder/details/jamembers/show/member/370/|url-status=dead}}</ref> She finished her PhD thesis "Algorithms for the Analysis of Biomolecular Simulations: Ensemble Averages, Marginal Distributions, Clustering, and Markov Models" in the group of Wilfred F. van Gunsteren in 2009.<ref name="www.bcp.fu-berlin.de-2014" /><ref name="www.academia-net.org" /> From January 2010 to July 2010, she was a visiting lecturer at [[Centre Européen de Calcul Atomique et Moléculaire|CECAM]] Node "Scientific Computing in the Molecular Sciences" at [[Free University of Berlin|Freie Universität Berlin]].<ref name="www.bcp.fu-berlin.de-2014" /> From July 2010 to September 2013, she was a postdoctoral researcher at Freie Universität Berlin.<ref name="www.diejungeakademie.de" /> From October 2013 to September 2019, she was a junior professor for Theoretical Chemistry at Freie Universität Berlin.<ref name="www.bcp.fu-berlin.de-2014" /> Since September 2019, she is a professor for Theoretical Chemistry at Freie Universität Berlin.<ref name="www.bcp.fu-berlin.de-2014" />

== Awards ==
*2018: Hans G. A. Hellmann-Preis for Theoretical Chemistry awarded by the Arbeitsgemeinschaft Theoretische Chemie<ref name="www.bcp.fu-berlin.de-2014" />
*Since June 2016: Member of the Junge Akademie of the [[Berlin-Brandenburg Academy of Sciences and Humanities]] (BBAW) and the [[German National Academy of Sciences Leopoldina]]<ref name="www.diejungeakademie.de" />
